# AI Agents for HR | IBM watsonx Orchestrate

Empower employees, managers and HR professionals with enterprise-ready AI agents that work with your existing systems.
Today’s HR teams face rising employee expectations, global talent shortages and a growing skills gap. Fragmented systems, manual processes and shrinking budgets slow them down.
AI agents for HR help teams meet those demands. They complete tasks across your HR systems, so your team can spend its time building an engaged, high-performing workforce. AI agents for HR are software agents that answer employee questions, complete HR transactions and move requests through your existing systems without manual handoffs.
Build AI agents on our intuitive interface, no coding skills required. Preview, optimize for your specific HR workflows and deploy rapidly.
Use prebuilt tools to connect agents to common enterprise applications, including 80+ leading enterprise apps.
Deploy agents to the channels your employees already work in, including Slack, Teams and your HR portal.
Accelerate HR transformation with enterprise-ready, prebuilt AI agents
AI agents for HR automate complex HR tasks across systems—securely, intelligently and at scale. Grounded in your data, they deliver fast, natural interactions through a single conversational interface.
Employees, managers and HR professionals get what they need without switching tools or waiting for help. Backed by IBM's own HR transformation, these customizable AI agents connect to your existing systems and support employee service, hiring, performance and learning with no rebuilds required.
These prebuilt AI agents act and adapt across the employee lifecycle, from hiring through learning and performance. Use them as they are, or as a starting point to build your own.
Resolve employee requests instantly, without waiting on emails or ticket queues.
Give employees a single conversational interface for HR tasks instead of switching between tools.
Every interaction follows company policy and local regulations automatically.
Automate sourcing, screening and interview scheduling so recruiters can move candidates through the process faster.
Free your team from repetitive tasks so they can focus on culture, engagement and growth.
Integrate with your HR, IT and business tools without replacing what you already run.
IBM watsonx Orchestrate empowers HR teams to launch AI agents that work with 80+ leading enterprise apps.
IBM HR enhanced AskHR’s generative AI and agentic automation capabilities with watsonx Orchestrate, delivering measurable, enterprise-wide impact.
Deliver consistent support experiences across channels with enterprise-ready AI agents that connect to your existing systems.
Help finance teams improve speed, accuracy and decision-making with AI agents that require no code.
Turn documents, cloud content and internal knowledge into citation-backed answers with AI knowledge agents that deploy in days.
Improve resiliency and cost efficiency with prebuilt AI agents that connect across your supply chain systems.
